overview:
**Fire danger is Low across the Montrose High Elevation area today, with gusty northeast winds the only flag tripped.**
- Danger stays Low through November 8, with ERC and BI percentiles holding in the mid-30s to mid-40s all week.
- Winds are today's main driver: 18 mph ENE now exceeds the local threshold, but forecast winds ease to single digits by midweek as a cooler, calmer pattern sets in.
- Only 1 of 7 local watchout thresholds is met (wind speed); no Red Flag Warning is in effect, and a Winter Storm Warning covers high terrain in the San Juans into Monday afternoon.
- Gunnison Field Office Stage 1 fire restrictions have been lifted, and Ouray County has rescinded all fire restrictions for unincorporated areas; no local fire bans are currently active.
- No active wildfires are reported in or near this area in the latest interagency situation update.
